notes.title: Ingression | Trial Level Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hey-hey, runners![/b][/h1]
We have great news for you all along with a fantastic update! Let's start with the update. We've added a new trial level menu and the latest trial level, “November ‘2024”. From now on, your achievements in the trial levels will be remembered forever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/03a279e3c71a82b4a040b6703147552cf3a78de1.png[/img]
[b]And the great news[/b] - we’re working to bring Ingression to the Nintendo Switch! It’s a tough path with a lot of challenges to solve before it can happen, so be sure to subscribe to our media and stay tuned for announcements!

Full Patch Notes:
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a trial level selection menu where you can play the latest trial and view leaderboards for previous and current trials.
[*] Added trial level “November ‘24”.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the “switch slot” label displayed “clear slot” text.
[/list]
Thank you for playing! We’d love to see your personal best results on the new trial level page!

[b]Additionally, Ingression is part of Games from Turkey 2024! This is a great opportunity to purchase it at a 30% discount until November 9th, 10 am PT.[/b]

[h2]Oh, and don't forget about our socials!
[/h2]

► Discord - https://discord.com/invite/nrcfABDUhV

notes.title: Ingression | Major Update
notes.notes:
Hey runners,
In this update, we've hidden a lot of shiny things in some levels, and you can try to find them NOW!

This update brings new collectibles. By collecting them, you can unlock new levels. Also, you can test your speedrun skills on the new trial level.

Full patch note:
[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] Added 5 collectible chronothyst gems to chapters 1, 2, 3 & 4; which unlocks a master level for the corresponding chapter after collecting them all in a chapter – You can access them from the Chapter Select Page.
[*] Added 4 new achievements for completing each master level and 1 for completing all of them.
[/list]
[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the checkpoint portals’ ambient SFXs in Sector X.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400009/4aa8b8af4eda9ab8249def4fcedda8a1838d48e4.png[/img]

You can now check out the Soundtrack page, where we've gathered all the music from the game, created by the Kargamanes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971740/Ingression_Soundtrack

Thank you for playing! We are eagerly awaiting your personal best results on the leaderboards!

Additionally, the game is part of the Steam Summer Sale, and it's a great opportunity to purchase it at a 30% discount until July 11th, 10 am PDT.

[h2][b]Oh, and don't forget about our socials![/b][/h2]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.28, May 19th
notes.notes:
[h1]v1.0.28[/h1]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased the font sizes of the dropdowns in the options menu and the texts of save slot buttons for a better experience on the Steam Deck, and smaller screens.
[*] Display settings are now saved locally and won’t get cloud-saved, allowing a smoother transition between different devices. [i]Please note that your previous display settings will be lost with this update – sorry![/i]
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some typos in Turkish localization.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.25, May 15th
notes.notes:
[h1]v1.0.25[/h1]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] The credits scene is no longer muted, it plays the main menu theme.
[*] Removed spikes from some levels of Chapter 3 for more forgiveness.
[*] Trial Mode spoiler warning will no longer be displayed if you’ve beaten the game on the current save slot.
[*] Scaled some font sizes of the dialogue UI, the options page, the save slot page, and alert dialogues for a better experience on the Steam Deck, and smaller screens.
[/list]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed speedrun timer only displaying up to an hour. Now, it can display up to 24 hours and “23:59:59:000+” for anything above.
[*] Fixed the death counter displaying the Total and Chapter death counts wrong.
[*] Fixed an unintentional skip on the 5th level of Chapter 2.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.19, May 7th - Chinese Font Fix
notes.notes:
[h1]v1.0.19[/h1]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added more lamps to the 22nd level of the First Chapter for more visibility.
[*] Removed spikes from some levels from Chapter 1 and Prologue for more forgiveness.
[*] Changed the style of the version displayed in the main menu.
[*] Decreased the volume of [spoiler]Holo Butler SFXs in Chapter 4[/spoiler].
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed readability issues with the Chinese font.
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Holo Butler audio stacking issue in Chapter 4[/spoiler].
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.15, May 6th
notes.notes:
[h1]v1.0.15[/h1]

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Vsync dropdown getting stuck in the options menu.
[*] Removed the unobtainable [i]“An unusual way”[/i] achievement.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now obtain the [i]“Chapter Stealth”[/i] achievement in a save slot, even if you failed before. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.13, May 4th
notes.notes:
[h1]v1.0.13[/h1]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing background textures on the second level of the Epilogue.
[*] Fixed overlapping text on the credits page, when using simplified Chinese.
[/list]
[h2]Changed[/h2]
